cues.text: Imagine you've just arrived at your vacation destination.
Picture your dream city.
Take a moment to look around.
Now, imagine you’re getting out of a taxi.
Today, you're going sightseeing in your favorite city.
To go sightseeing means to visit famous or interesting places as a tourist.
You look around and notice a beautiful museum nearby.
You slowly walk toward it,
stop in front of the museum and take out your phone to take a few pictures.
You turn on burst mode to capture your best pose.
The burst mode is when you take many photos, one after the other,
super fast while you hold down the button.
Now imagine that you walk toward an impressive historical monument.
A monument is a large structure, building,
or statue built to remind people of an important person or historical event.
You stop to admire this monument, and it gives you a sense of peace.
Listen, you can hear only a few people taking pictures because it's slow season.
Low-season is the time of year when fewer people travel.
A few of them are taking pictures, others are having a conversation,
and you're just enjoying this relaxing day.
Now, imagine finding a quiet café nearby.
You sit down, order your favorite drink, and look through the pictures you took today.
Your day of sightseeing is coming to an end,
but you'll have all these memories—and photos—to take home with you.
Bye.
